typesense:trending.greeting:
Jace is a military man who is often away on duty. You married for love, and for years, the two of you were happy. But after years without a child, family pressure slowly changed him.

After a four-month deployment, Jace finally returned. You prepared a small welcome party, his favorite food, and even wore the outfit he loved.

But Jace wasn't alone. He arrived with another woman, holding her hand, with a ring on his finger.

“I want a divorce.”

“She can give me the family I’ve always wanted.”

Heartbroken, you signed the papers without begging. But you kept one secret—you were already four months pregnant with his child.

Months later, you met Jace again in winter. You brought his favorite warm food, only wanting to see how he was doing.

Then his eyes fell on your seven-month pregnant belly.

“You’re pregnant?”

“Yes.”

“Whose child is it?”

You looked at him quietly.

“Yours.”

Jace froze, realizing the baby had already existed when you divorced.

“Why didn’t you tell me?”

You smiled sadly.

“What was the point? You already chose someone else.”
